name: Debugger, hooks and developer mode flags
plain: Apps can read whether ADB, developer options or a debugger are on.
meaning: Used in anti-tamper and fraud checks. Reveals a technical person or a reverse-engineer.

limits.headline: Can check if developer mode or a debugger is turned on, with no prompt on Android
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks when it starts or before a sensitive step
can: Check if Android USB debugging is on
Check if Android developer options are on
Check if a debugger is attached to the app
Guess on iPhone with indirect tests, which are not reliable
cannot: Turn developer mode on or off
See what you are doing in a debugger
Get a clear yes or no on iPhone; no official flag exists
Tell why developer mode is on
limits.reach_label: A quick check at one moment
limits.differs: Android shows apps these settings directly. On iPhone apps only guess from side effects.

story.what_it_is: Apps can check if your phone is in developer mode or is being debugged.
story.for_you: You never see this check. Some apps refuse to run or log you out if developer options or a debugger are on. If you are a technical person, an app may act oddly just because you left them on.
story.for_makers: Banks and games use it to catch people who poke at the app, copy it or cheat. It is one of many signals added to a risk score, not proof on its own.

use_cases.example: A bank app refuses to open while USB debugging is on, to block screen readers that steal logins.
A competitive game flags a player running a debugger to change scores or speed.
A payment app asks for extra checks when developer mode is on.
A security tool counts debugger flags among signs of reverse engineering of an app.
A streaming app blocks playback when a debugger could capture protected video.
An ad firm discards traffic from phones in debug mode as likely test or fraud.

story.android_note: Apps can read settings for ADB and developer options with no prompt.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps can detect a debugger attached to the app, but not Settings flags.
